note: Real captures only. Each entry names where it came from. Stills live in public/media/<id>-<width>.webp, one file per width in `widths`. Clips are film-evidence release assets that build-content.mjs downloads at build time. Label anything that is not final as work in progress.

stills.alt: The main street of the playtest village: a narrow asphalt road between old plastered houses with tiled roofs, yellow lamp posts, a bus shelter, and a parked sedan.
stills.caption: The main street of the M1 playtest village, built from vanilla Everon buildings. Every site in the loop sits along this road.

stills.alt: A cobbled village square with a stone fountain, two large lime trees, green benches, and houses beyond.
stills.caption: The square at the spawn: cobbles, a fountain, the pub, lime trees. A new player starts here.

stills.alt: A grey two-storey post office with a yellow post box on the porch, beside a pink-roofed building and a lamp post.
stills.caption: The post office, where delivery jobs start: a counter and a post box on the porch.

stills.alt: A white three-storey police station with a forecourt holding a desk, crates, and figures in uniform.
stills.caption: The police station forecourt: duty desk, armory, and the whitelist check.

stills.alt: A road past a weathered apartment block towards a red and white fuel station canopy, with a yellow till counter in the foreground.
stills.caption: The hospital till and the fuel station till, the two small robberies on the street.

stills.alt: A cork notice board in the old grid test world with a paper sheet that reads MINING AREA. Soldiers stand at tables and a spoil heap in the background.
stills.caption: A sign board with its site name printed on the paper. The game draws the title onto the sheet; nothing is added afterwards.

stills.alt: A mining site in the old grid test world: a conveyor tower, a rusty ore bucket, tables with crates, and a spoil heap.
stills.caption: The mining site, filmed by the harness walking the street as a player.

stills.alt: A wide shot of the old test street from above: cars, desks, crates, a garage and jeeps in one row on a white grid.
stills.caption: Before the village: every site in one row on a white grid.

stills.alt: The playtest village from the air: a short road with a dozen houses, trees, and fields, on a flat green test terrain.
stills.caption: The village from the south-west, with the fenced test annex out of shot.

clips.title: Harness tour, before the village
clips.caption: The first clip from the filming harness: an agent plays the game client, walks the old grid street, and records it. 20 seconds, no edits.
